notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.6d
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate your interest in the Torrent Empire demo and the great feedback you’ve shared with us! With this update, we’ve fixed a few issues and made various improvements. You can find the details below.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

🐛 A rare error in software cracking games has been fixed.
🚫 The side menu has been removed.
🔔 The notification system has been adjusted.
🌐 Various translation errors have been fixed.

[b]New Features:[/b]

🖥️ Now, when you connect to VDS, it opens as a window within the game.
📏 You can resize many of the windows in the game.
📋 A taskbar has been added.
⌨️ The ability to copy commands using CTRL + A has been added to the terminal command input area.
🗺️ The server map attacks and functions in the game have been completely revamped.
📝 An informative message has been added for the first task.

If you encounter any issues while playing the demo, please let us know. We’re also looking forward to your suggestions.

[b]And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703940/Torrent_Empire/

notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.5d
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate your interest in the Torrent Empire demo and the great feedback you’ve shared with us! With this update, we’ve fixed a few issues and made various improvements. You can find the details below.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

🗡️ Attack frequency has been reduced; you will face fewer attacks in the early stages of the game.
🛠️ Improvements have been made regarding the issue where the game would not launch or remain on a white screen for a small number of players.
🪟 The issue of tutorial windows overlapping has been fixed, and a background color has been added to these windows.
📐 Improvements have been made for the attack map on low screen resolutions.
✅  The command used to close the game now works more accurately.
🌐 Missing translation texts have been corrected.
🔧 Improvements have been made regarding the server panel overflowing outside the screen.
🎨 The use of the color command in the menu screen has been improved.

[b]New Features:[/b]

🔀 Alias and unalias commands have been added, allowing you to customize and create shortcuts for commands within the game.
🎯 The terminal input focus no longer disappears.
↹ You can now quickly complete commands using the TAB key.
🗺️ A menu icon has been added to the attack map, allowing you to quickly open windows from there if desired.
🔣 Shortcuts have been added for commands like yes, no, and quit.
🖱️ The loading window can now be dragged.
🚨 When the server crashes, the warning now includes the command needed to restart it.
📊 A window has been added to view various statistics when the demo version ends.

[b]Important Note:[/b] With this version, changes have been made to the file structure for various performance improvements and bug fixes. Therefore, your old save file will NOT WORK with this update.

If you encounter any issues while playing the demo, please let us know. We’re also looking forward to your suggestions.

[b]And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703940/Torrent_Empire/

notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.4d
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate your interest in the Torrent Empire demo and the great feedback you’ve shared with us! With this update, we’ve fixed a few issues and made various improvements. You can find the details below.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

📚 Fixed the issue where the Node Threat tutorial would reappear after closing and reopening the game.
⏰ Resolved the problem where the FastBurger task in the demo wasn’t visible for some players.

[b]New Features:[/b]

🔧 You can now view and reuse previously entered commands in the terminal using the up arrow key.
🧹 Use the new 'shut' command to close all open windows on the screen.
🔒 On the SERVER NETWORK, the initial part of the terminal command you need to enter for emerging threats is now automatically added to the terminal by the system.
📖 The 'connect' command, needed to connect to tasks, has been added to the help menu.
📂 Various help texts have been added to the VDS interface.

If you encounter any issues while playing the demo, please let us know. We’re also looking forward to your suggestions.

[b]And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]
